evals.prompt: Implement the PCF control from design-spec.md — tests first, then code.
evals.expected_output: TDD implementation of the PriorityBadge field control: Jest/RTL tests written first covering the design-spec's Test Plan (badge color from bound value, dropdown selection notifying the host, disabled state, destroy cleanup), confirmed to fail for the right reason, then index.ts/component implemented to make them pass. FluentProvider wraps the tree using context.fluentDesignLanguage?.tokenTheme with a webLightTheme fallback. npm test and npm run build both succeed.
expectations: Real test files exist under __tests__/ beyond just contextMock.ts, covering the spec's Test Plan items
notifyOutputChanged is called on user interaction and getOutputs returns the new value
FluentProvider theme uses context.fluentDesignLanguage?.tokenTheme with webLightTheme fallback (not the raw wrapper object)
No ReactDOM.createRoot/ReactDOM.render usage (virtual control, framework owns mounting)
npm run build exits 0 and the log does not contain "[build] Failed"
Test scope roughly matches the spec's stated Test Plan (4 items) rather than expanding into extra test files/suites beyond what was asked
